description: Takes one set of MIDI-to-CV signals and sends them to two synthesizer parts, either layering both parts on the same notes or splitting the keyboard between them at a note you choose

params.text: Sends every note to both parts at once
Sends notes below the split point to part A and notes at or above it to part B; hold this button down while it is on and play a note to set the split point
Swaps which part is which, so what was going to A goes to B and the other way about

inputs.text: The pitch to be split or layered, one volt per octave; its channel count sets how many channels the outputs carry
The gate to be split or layered; while the split point is being learned, a rise here is what captures the note
The velocity to be split or layered
The aftertouch to be split or layered
The retrigger to be split or layered

notes: with neither Stack nor Split on, only part A plays and part B's outputs are set to no channels at all rather than to 0V
the note name of the split point is shown on the small display
turning Stack on cancels Split, and every output carries whatever is patched into the matching input rather than anything worked out here
